visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a white beret and a man in a white t-shirt stand in a modern, brightly lit indoor space, looking at the camera. A small inset video shows a garden eel in the sand. (2) A vertical montage begins showing a single, long, spotted garden eel swimming freely in a blue-tinted aquarium tank, revealing its full length which is surprisingly thin and long. (3) The woman walks up a flight of stairs in the venue, wearing a pink cardigan over her white top, gesturing with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera. (4) A close-up shot of the aquarium floor shows several garden eels peeking out from the sand while a yellow fish swims past them. (5) Back to the woman on the stairs, she brings the camera close to her face, showing high excitement with wide eyes and pointing gestures while continuing to talk in the brightly lit hallway.
